name: Torrid-Bastion
description: There is no surface, only an endless fall through banded clouds: amber belts, cream zones, and storms wide enough to swallow worlds. Lightning flickers between the layers like thoughts of a vast mind.
Downward the pressure builds into black liquid air; upward, the storms scream past at jet speeds. There is no calm layer to stand in, only depths that tolerate visitors briefly.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
